name: herdwise-gateway
description: HCS048 telemetry gateway — TCP listener, protocol codec, device simulator.

scripts.db:reset: dropdb --if-exists herdwise_dev; createdb herdwise_dev; for f in ../supabase/migrations/*.sql; do psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -q -d herdwise_dev -f $f || exit 1; done; psql -q -d herdwise_dev -f ../supabase/seed.sql
